name: clinic-api
description: The single backend service of the clinic: owns doctors, patients, availability slots, appointments and visit notes, enforces no double booking (P1), the 2-hour cancellation cut-off (P2) and doctors-only visit notes (P3), and verifies the gateway's signed assertion on every call. One service because all entities share one transactional booking rule set; it does not send notifications, run background jobs, store files or call external systems. Persistence is held in the service's own store; no backing resource is declared because none is registered in this organization.
